excerpt.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
excerpt.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

texts.zh: 一大群反常的子个体在[This.GetName]殖民地引发暴乱，造成了大规模破坏。尽管这些分子非常疯狂，防御部队还是迅速镇压了这些煽动者。然而，基础设施所遭受的损伤仍需时间来修复。
texts.en: A large pod of deviant drones led a revolt in the [This.GetName] colony, causing widespread destruction. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the agitators, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

texts.zh: [This.GetName]上有一小群无人机感染了一种神秘的病毒，开始反抗并试图摧毁殖民地。尽管他们非常疯狂，防御部队还是将这些故障单元迅速解决，但我们基础设施受到的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
texts.en: A significant minority of the drones on [This.GetName] were infected by a mysterious virus, causing them to rebel and attempt to destroy the colony. Despite their fervor, defense forces were able to neutralize the malfunctioning units, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

texts.zh:
[This.GetName]上四处爆发了危险的骚乱。一种关于[From.GetAdjective]政府操纵天象的无端阴谋论激起了强烈的民愤。狂热示威很快演变成暴力冲突，煽动者在殖民地各处大肆破坏。

暴力游行很快被安全部队镇压，但对我们基础设施的损伤仍需要时间来修复。
texts.en:
Dangerous riots have erupted across [This.GetName]. The population is fueled with fervor in protest of an unsubstantiated conspiracy about the [From.GetAdjective] government's control of celestial alignments. What began as a zealous demonstration soon devolved into violence, with agitators causing mass destruction throughout the colony.

The violent demonstrators were neutralized by security forces, but the damage to our infrastructure will take time to repair.

summary.text:
# 自发骚乱 / Spontaneous Uproar

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789`; `events/shroud_events.txt:645-760,961-1221`; `common/scripted_variables/09_scripted_variables_shroud.txt:43`; `events/shroud_events.txt:3137-3216`
- DLC：Shadows of the Shroud
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

迷信者（Superstitious Beliefs）文明的周期事件触发：每个13年周期开始（首个周期除外）掷出吉或凶（shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415，events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221），再从 on_action 的16个等权事件中抽取一个（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789）；本事件每个帝国至多一次（国家旗标 shroud_735_triggered）。凶兆事件。拥有符合条件的行星（sb_spontaneous_uproar_planet_trigger）。分流 shroud.735 → 737。

Triggered by the cycles of a Superstitious Beliefs empire: each 13-year cycle (except the first) rolls good or bad luck (shroud.210/220/230 → 410/415, events/shroud_events.txt:961-1221) and one of the 16 equally weighted events of that on_action is drawn (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5749-5789); this event happens at most once per empire (country flag shroud_735_triggered). A bad luck event. Owns a planet satisfying sb_spontaneous_uproar_planet_trigger. Router shroud.735 → 737.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

单窗口通知，无后续剧情；唯一的选项直接生效。唯一选项：该行星增加25点破坏度并杀死一个人口。

A single notification window with no continuation; its only option applies directly. Only option: +25 planet devastation and one pop is killed.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无分支；与同一抽取池中另外15个事件互不相关，各自独立成卡。

No branching; independent of the other 15 events of the same draw pool, each shown as its own card.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文分蜂巢 / 机械 / 其他三种。

Three body texts (hive / machine / other).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

对照脚本核实了触发条件、旗标、选项效果和本地化；触发链（周期→吉凶掷骰→on_action）已核对。

Trigger, flag, option effects and localisation were checked against the script; the trigger chain (cycle → luck roll → on_action) was verified.
